add_mask_rcnn_outputs: add Mask R-CNN mask prediction outputs using fully connected or convolutional layers with optional upsampling
add_mask_rcnn_losses: add Mask R-CNN specific loss computation using sigmoid cross entropy loss on mask predictions
mask_rcnn_fcn_head_v1up4convs: build a Mask R-CNN mask head with 4 conv 3x3 layers and a transposed conv 2x2 upsampling layer
mask_rcnn_fcn_head_v1up4convs_gn: build a Mask R-CNN mask head with 4 conv 3x3 layers and GroupNorm plus transposed conv upsampling
mask_rcnn_fcn_head_v0upshare: build a Mask R-CNN mask head that shares ResNet conv5 weights with the box head during training
